Commentary.Commentary: Bangladesh, on the other hand, started slowly with Tamim Iqbal and Mohammad Hasnain going at a snail's pace. Once they started to attack, they lost their way and lost wickets. Mohammad Naim played a good knock while Tamim struggled. Mahmudullah gave them some runs in the end but it might not be enough. They need to bowl extremely well to restrict the hosts. Will they be able to do it? Join us in a while.

Excellent bowling performance from Pakistan. They never let Bangladesh take the attack to them. Every bowler bowled well and were economical which has led Bangladesh to a below par score on this track. Mohammad Hasnain the only expensive bowler while Haris Rauf bowled with a lot of pace on his debut. Shadab Khan was good as well and they need to follow this up with the bat to go 1-0 up in the series.
Full toss on middle, Mahmudullah works it to deep square leg for a single. BANGLADESH FINISH ON 141 FOR 5.
EDGY FOUR! Handy runs these! Full delivery outside off, Mahmudullah looks to heave it away but it takes the top edge and the ball goes over the short third man fielder for a boundary.
Short ball outside off, Mithun punches it to deep cover for a single.
FOUR! Nicely timed! Full delivery outside off, Mithun lunges and drives it through the cover region for a boundary.
Short ball on middle, Mahmudullah pulls it to mid-wicket for a single.
Slower delivery outside off, Mahmudullah drives it to mid off for a couple.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.

OUT! TIMBER! Nicely bowled! Slower delivery on middle, Sarkar looks to heave it away but fails to get any bat on it. The ball goes onto hit the middle stump and Pakistan are ecstatic.  Bangladesh are struggling to make a terrific finish in the death overs. Mohammad Mithun is the new man in.
Yorker down the leg side, Mahmudullah looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. The keeper fails to collect it cleanly and the batters steal a leg bye.
Good length ball on off, pushed to point.

NOT OUT! Poor review as it is pitching down leg. Full delivery on the pads. Mahmudullah looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. Shaheen appeals but the umpire is not interested. Afridi convinces Babar Azam for the review and he obliges. The Ultra Edge rolls in and it shows that there is no bat on it. The Ball Tracker then rolls in and it shows that the ball was pitching outside leg. Good decision from the umpire. The ball rolls to the off side and the batters take a single.
Babar Azam has taken the review for an LBW. Mahmudullah is the man in question. It looks like going down leg. The Ultra edge shows no bat. The Ball Tracker shows it is pitching outside leg.
Full delivery outside off, Sarkar drives it to cover and takes off for a single. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Had he hit, Sarkar was well out.
Fullish ball outside off, Sarkar drives it to deep cover for a single.
FOUR! Poor delivery to follow up the wicket ball! Fullish delivery on the pads, Sarkar just help it on its way to the fine leg region for a boundary.
Soumya Sarkar is the new man in.

OUT! TIMBER! What a proud moment for Haris Rauf. Gets his first wicket in international cricket. He is ecstatic and why wouldn't he be? Rauf dishes a full ball on middle, Hossain looks to lift it over the leg side but fails to get any bat on it. The ball goes on to hit the middle stump.
Very full delivery on middle, Mahmudullah pushes this down to long on for a single.
Full delivery on middle, Hossain looks to flick it to the leg side but it takes the inside edge, hits the pads and the ball rolls towards mid off. The batters take a single.
Full delivery down the leg side, Hossain makes room and then tries to heave it away but fails to get any bat on it.
WIDE! Rauf starts with a very full delivery outside off, Hossain shoulders arms. Wide signaled.
Haris Rauf is back on. 2-0-11-0 are his figures so far.
Full delivery on off, Hossain looks to scoop but but the ball takes the edge and the ball goes towards square leg. The batters take a single.
Yorker on middle, Hossain digs it out to mid-wicket and the batters take a couple before the bowler can come across and clean it up.
Full delivery on middle, Mahmudullah whips it to the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Needs more of these! Slower delivery on middle, Mahmudullah whips it uppishly towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Short delivery outside off, Afif pushes it to cover and crosses over for a single.
Full delivery on off, Mahmudullah defends it towards cover and takes off for a single.
Shaheen Afridi is back on. 2 overs for 11 so far.
Length ball on middle, Mahmudullah works it to deep square leg for a single.
Full delivery on middle, Hossain drives it to long on for a single.
Good length ball on off, Mahmudullah whips it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Short ball on middle, Hossain pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Good length ball on middle, Mahmudullah works it to square leg for a single. They think of a second but decide against it.
Good length ball on middle, Afif flicks it to square leg for a single.
Floated ball outside off, Hossain drives it to mid off to get off the mark with a single. 4-0-26-1 his figures.
Flatter delivery, pushed to point for a single.
Afif Hossain is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Naim has to depart and Bangladesh are crumbling here! Floated ball on middle, Naim dances down the track and looks to lift it over the long on region but does not get enough bat on it. It goes straight into the hands of Iftikhar Ahmed at long on. He takes a simple catch.
Mahmudullah is the new man in.

OUT! RUN OUT! Shadab Khan, you beauty. What piece of fielding. Floated ball outside off, Naim looks to flick but gets a leading edge towards cover. They want the second and they take off. Shadab runs after the ball and then throws it to the bowler's end. He hits the stumps. Shadab appeals but the others are not interested. The umpire goes upstairs and it shows that Das was out of his crease.
Third umpire has been called for a run out chance. Das is the man in question. It did not look out at first but the replays show that Das is out of his crease.
Flatter delivery outside off, Das cuts it to point and takes a single this time.
Flatter delivery outside off, Liton punches it to point.

Full delivery on middle, Naim works it to deep square leg for a couple.
Low full toss on off, Das defends it to cover for a single.
FOUR! Nicely played! Full delivery on the pads, Das works it to the deep square leg region for a boundary.
Full on off, Naim drives it to long on for a single.
Flatter delivery outside off, Das lets the ball go to the keeper.
Floated ball outside off, Das looks to defend but misses it altogether.
The batsman was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.
Flighted ball outside off, Das attempts the sweep but fails to get any bat on it.
Top edge but safe! Loopy delivery outisde off, Naim looks to go over extra cover but it takes the top edge and goes to extra cover. The batters take a single.
SIX! Nicely played! Loopy delivery outside off, Naim lunges and lofts it over the extra cover region for a maximum.
FOUR! Floated ball down the leg side, Das sweeps it to the fine leg region for a boundary.
On off, guided to point.

On middle, nudged to mid-wicket for a single.
Full delivery on middle, Das works it to mid off for a single.
Floated on middle, Naim works it to deep square leg for a single.
Wide! Floated ball outside off, Naim lets it go to the keeper. Wide signaled.

OUT! RUN OUT! Pakistan have broken through courtesy a run out. Floated ball on middle, Tamim works it to deep square leg. He wants the couple and takes off. The fielder runs ahead and throws it to the keeper. The keeper does the rest as he whips the bails off. Tamim dives but has that saved him? The third umpire is called into question. The replays show that Tamim is well out despite his dive. He walks back disappointed.
Bangladesh need something big here.
Run out appeal has been taken upstairs. Tamim is walking back and that indicates that he is well out. Let's see what happens.
A short delivery which has been pulled away. The batsmen have run through for a single.
BEATEN! Floated one outside off, Naim looks to play the reverse sweep but fails to get any bat on it.
A googly on the pads, Naim defends it out to the bowler.

SIX! Finally, Bangladesh take the attack to the Pakistani. Loopy delivery on middle, Iqbal bends on his knees and slog sweeps it over the deep square leg region for a biggie.
Good length ball on middle, Tamim drives it to mid off for a single. only 62 runs have come in the first 10 overs.

Slower delivery on middle, Naim flicks it uppishly towards long on. It lands safely and the batters take a single.
BEATEN! Full delivery outside off, Naim looks to swing it away to the off side but fails to get any bat on it.
Length ball on middle, Iqbal works it to mid-wicket for a single.

Loopy delivery outside off, Naim looks to drive but it takes the bottom edge of the bat and the ball goes to short third man. No run.
Flatter one on middle, Tamim works it to mid-wicket for a single.
WIDE! Shorter delivery down the leg side. Naim lets it go to the keeper. It is wided by the umpire.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Loopy delivery on middle, Iqbal works it to deep square leg for a single.
WIDE! Poor delivery! Short delivery down the leg side, Iqbal looks to pull but fails to get any bat on it. Wide signaled.
Floated delivery on off, pushed to cover.
Khan starts with a loopy delivery on middle, Naim works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.

Low full toss on middle, Naim works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fullish on off, pushed to cover.
Length ball down the leg side, Iqbal works it to fine leg for a single. 50-run stand is up between the two.
FOUR! Good response from Iqbal! Short delivery down the leg side. Tamim gets into position quickly and then pulls it to the deep square leg region for a boundary.
Tamim has hurt himself and has called for the physio.
Nasty! Short of a length ball on off, Tamim rocks back to pull but it takes the inside edge and goes onto hit Iqbal near the box.
EDGY FOUR! Good length ball outside off, Iqbal looks to defend but the ball takes the outside edge and goes to the third man fence for a boundary.

Short ball on middle, Naim pulls it to deep mid-wicket and pick up a couple before the fielder can come across and clean it up.

Well fielded! Good length ball outside off, Tamim thrashes it towards point where the fielder makes a good stop. 35/0 from the Powerplay.

Excellent yorker from Shaheen! Yorker on middle, Naim gets his bat down in time and digs it out.

Bangladesh are underway! Floated on middle, Iqbal works it to deep mid-wicket for a couple before the fielder can come across and clean it up.

We are all set for the action to begin!!! The Pakistan players are making their way out to the middle, followed by the two Bangladesh openers, Tamim Iqbal and Mohammad Naim. Imad Wasim will start with the ball for the hosts.
The action is not too far away!!! First up are the National Anthems of both the sides.
Bangladesh (PLAYING XI) - Tamim Iqbal, Mohammad Naim, Afif Hossain, Liton Das (WK), Mahmudullah (C), Soumya Sarkar, Mohammad Mithun, Aminul Islam, Shafiul Islam, Mustafizur Rahman, Al-Amin Hossain.

Pakistan (PLAYING XI) - Ahsan Ali (DEBUT), Babar Azam (C), Mohammad Hafeez, Shoaib Malik, Iftikhar Ahmed, Imad Wasim, Mohammad Rizwan (WK), Shadab Khan, Haris Rauf (DEBUT), Shaheen Afridi, Mohammad Hasnain.
Toss -  Bangladesh have won the toss and they choose to bat first.

Amidst all the confusion regarding the tour, Bangladesh land in Pakistan. Pakistan are having a torrid time in T20Is and they would look to perform better under Babar Azam's captaincy. Bangladesh, on the other hand, played well against India but they could not pass the final hurdle. They would hope that without Mushfiqur Rahim, they will be able to beat this Pakistan team and start the series with a win.
